inspiration_processing_completion.name: inspiration_processing_completion
inspiration_processing_completion.value: "inspiration_processing"."material_revision" > 0 AND ("inspiration_processing"."completed_at" IS NULL OR ("inspiration_processing"."derived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inspiration_processing"."result" IS NOT NULL))

inspiration_processing_request_versions.name: inspiration_processing_request_versions
inspiration_processing_request_versions.value: ("inspiration_processing"."derivation_job_id" IS NULL OR ("inspiration_processing"."derivation_request_version" IS NOT NULL AND "inspiration_processing"."derivation_request_version" > 0)) AND ("inspiration_processing"."reading_job_id" IS NULL OR ("inspiration_processing"."reading_request_version" IS NOT NULL AND "inspiration_processing"."reading_request_version" > 0))

inspiration_save_requests_result.name: inspiration_save_requests_result

signal_evidence_support_revisions_positi.name: signal_evidence_support_revisions_positive
signal_evidence_support_revisions_positi.value:
("signal_evidence"."statement_revision" IS NULL OR "signal_evidence"."statement_revision" > 0)
      AND ("signal_evidence"."material_revision" IS NULL OR "signal_evidence"."material_revision" > 0)

signal_evidence_private_quote_check.name: signal_evidence_private_quote_check
signal_evidence_private_quote_check.value:
"signal_evidence"."quote_reflection_id" IS NULL OR
      ("signal_evidence"."profile_id" = "signal_evidence"."owner_profile_id" AND "signal_evidence"."quote" IS NOT NULL
       AND ("signal_evidence"."quote_source" = 'own') IS TRUE AND "signal_evidence"."quote_source_hash" IS NOT NULL)

top_of_minds_owner_exclusive.name: top_of_minds_owner_exclusive
top_of_minds_owner_exclusive.value: ("top_of_minds"."profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "top_of_minds"."group_id" IS NULL) OR ("top_of_minds"."profile_id" IS NULL AND "top_of_minds"."group_id" IS NOT NULL)
